title: rapanea st-johnii
intro: Rapanea st-johnii, commonly known as New Zealand pepper tree, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Rapanea st-johnii include stimulating digestion, relieving respiratory issues, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of the plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
